name: board_ver_ctrl
description: Board version/BOM control. Documented quirk: firmware currently always returns a fixed 0x0002, regardless of actual hardware/BOM version.

name: drct_clk_en
description: Clock source selection for RX/TX interfaces (direct vs. PLL clocking).

name: stream_ctrl
description: Sample-width and interface-mode control. Only smpl_width[1:0], trxiq_pulse[7], mimo_int_en[8] and synch_dis[9] are writable; other bits are read-only pass-through.

name: reg09
description: Packet control: TX packet-loss clear and timestamp reset.

name: wfm_ch_en
description: WFM player channel enable control (DDR2/WFM-capable variants only, guarded by DDR_MODULES_PRESENT).

name: wfm_ctrl2
description: WFM player sample-width/play/load control (DDR2/WFM-capable variants only, guarded by DDR_MODULES_PRESENT).

name: txant_pre
description: Number of samples to delay turning on the internal TDD signal.

name: txant_post
description: Number of samples to delay turning off the internal TDD signal.

name: lms1
description: LMS7002 hard-enable/reset and digital-interface control. Write-only in the current firmware (no read-back case is implemented, so readback always returns 0).

name: lb_out_override
description: RF-loopback override value for the onboard TX1/TX2 loopback switches. Board-specific: writing this register also force-enables the override-enable bits for all loopback outputs (0xFF).

name: reg18
description: Board-specific control register (documented as reg18; not further decoded by firmware).

name: fpga_led_ctrl
description: Onboard FPGA LED1/LED2 override/control. The single legacy OVRD bit for each LED is fanned out to the independent green- and red-pin override-enable bits.

name: fx3_led_ctrl
description: Onboard FX3 activity LED override/control. The single legacy OVRD bit is fanned out to the independent green- and red-pin override-enable bits.

name: c1_phase
description: Phase value for PLL output clock 1.

name: pll_status
description: PLL and phase-configuration status. Board-specific: adds a pllcfg_error status bit at bit 7, in addition to the common pllcfg_done/pllcfg_busy/phcfg_done/phcfg_err bits.

name: pll_lock
description: PLL lock status (single PLL on this board).

name: pll_ctrl
description: PLL reconfiguration control: start triggers, PLL/counter index selection, and phase-shift direction/mode.

name: pllcfg_vcodiv
description: PLL VCO division control. Board-specific: only bit 7 (pllcfg_vcodiv) is wired; the loop-filter/charge-pump bits used on other boards are not implemented here.

name: mn_bypass_ctrl
description: M/N counter bypass and odd-division control.

name: c0..c4_byp_odddiv
description: Counter bypass and odd-division control bits for C0..C4. Board-specific: this board's PLL reconfiguration block has 5 output counters (C0..C4), unlike the 8-counter (C0..C7) block used on other boards.

name: phcfg_samples
description: Number of samples to compare during automatic phase configuration.

name: phcfg_step
description: Step size used during automatic phase configuration.

name: si5351c_clk7_cnt
description: Si5351C CLK7 counter value. Board-specific: this board's SI5351C counters are addressed in descending order (0x6A=CLK7 .. 0x71=CLK0), unlike the ascending order (0x6A=CLK0 .. 0x71=CLK7) used on other boards.

name: reserved
description: Reserved (no Si5351C CLK4 counter on this board).

name: ddr2_1_pnf_per_bit_l
description: DDR2_1 data [15:0] pass/fail-per-bit result. Board-specific: LimeSDR-USB has WFM-player-driven DDR2 self-test registers not present on other boards.

name: reserved
description: Reserved on this board (TX test pattern I register is not implemented in LimeSDR-USB firmware).

name: reserved
description: Reserved on this board (TX test pattern Q register is not implemented in LimeSDR-USB firmware).

name: board_gpio_dir
description: Board GPIO direction control. Legacy convention (1=output) is inverted from the underlying gpio_io CSR's convention (0=output) by the firmware.

name: reserved
description: Reserved for this board. PERIPH_INPUT_SEL is defined in the shared register layout but not wired in LimeSDR-USB firmware (commented out in regremap.c).

name: periph_output_ovrd_0
description: Peripheral output override 0 (fan control override enable).

name: reserved
description: Reserved for this board. PERIPH_EN is defined in the shared register layout but not wired in LimeSDR-USB firmware (commented out in regremap.c).

name: reserved
description: Reserved for this board. PERIPH_SEL is defined in the shared register layout but not wired in LimeSDR-USB firmware (commented out in regremap.c).
